description: Every Unipile endpoint as a typed command, plus a local mirror that makes cross-provider search possible and an invitation ledger that shows how much LinkedIn headroom you have left.

auth_env_var_specs.name: UNIPILE_API_KEY
auth_env_var_specs.description: Unipile Access Token from the Unipile dashboard; sent as the X-API-KEY header.

novel_features.name: Rate-budget ledger
novel_features.description: See how many LinkedIn invitations you have left today and this week, counted from your synced invitation history.

novel_features.name: Offline cross-provider search
novel_features.description: Full-text search every message, email, attendee, and relation across all connected providers at once, offline.

novel_features.name: Contact 360
novel_features.description: Everything the local mirror knows about one person: connection state, invitation history, and every conversation with per-direction message counts.

novel_features.name: Unified unread inbox
novel_features.description: One table of everything unread across LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, and email.

novel_features.name: Silence detection
novel_features.description: Find conversations where you sent the last message and got no reply for N days.

novel_features.name: Accepted but not messaged
novel_features.description: New LinkedIn connections since your last sync that you have not messaged yet.

novel_features.name: Invitation funnel
novel_features.description: Sent, accepted, and replied counts with conversion rates over a time window.

novel_features.name: Cross-provider digest
novel_features.description: What changed across every connected provider since the last sync.

novel_features.name: Resolved thread view
novel_features.description: Read one conversation end to end with attendee IDs resolved to real names.

novel_features.name: Post engagement crossmatch
novel_features.description: Who reacted to or commented on your posts, flagged by whether they are already a connection.
